fullCarrierRequirement.branchCutMeaning: transport across the Z2 flux implements l -> -l
fullCarrierRequirement.factorizedImpostor: a decoupled toric-code flux acts trivially on the Leech momentum label

protocol: prepare all 23 clock labels or a tomographically complete subset
apply one translation before and after branch-cut transport
reconstruct whether conjugation sends T to T or T^-1
repeat with the branch cut removed as the factorized control

promotionGate.pass: branch-cut transport inverts the carrier label and the same flux participates in the m-condensed boundary extension
promotionGate.fail: the toric-code fusion and sqrt(2) interface are present but the flux acts trivially on carrier operators
promotionGate.meaning: passing establishes the symmetry-enriched orbifold parent; it still does not by itself establish the J-character or Monster defects

scope.toyRole: a finite order-23 process-tomography surrogate for the infinite Leech momentum-label action
scope.notClaimed: the Z23 clock labels are literally a basis of the Leech lattice or already identify Monster class 23AB
